integrity: A complete self-contained clique argument is provided, conditional only on a cited established pairwise characterization; finite tests are corroborative, not a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires the established Type-A characterization of one-deletion-ball intersections of size two.
Exact clique size and structural classification; does not determine independence or clique cover numbers.
source_date_basis: Original arXiv submission on September 15, 2026; older cited literature is supporting context.
title: Sharp clique bound and two-pencil structure in the two-read single-deletion graph
